name: peon-py
description: Another [openpeon](https://openpeon.com/) implementation for Claude Code / Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Play OpenPeon sound packs on coding-agent events
interface.longDescription: peon-py implements the OpenPeon CESP v1.0 player contract: it maps agent lifecycle hooks to the nine standard sound categories and plays audio from any of the 100+ community sound packs.
